rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records for the entire import is within 0.1% threshold.
Checks that currency exchange rate values are non-negative.
Checks that every currency exchange rate StatVar resolves to at least 1 place.
Ensure active currencies (EUR, INR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF, CNY) have MaxDate at or after 2025 to catch import stagnation.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate FROM stats WHERE regexp_matches(StatVar, '_ToCurrency_(EUR|INR|GBP|JPY|CAD|AUD|CHF|CNY)$')
